reviewer_reason: Chapter 1 has introduced Yoda's class, and chapter 2 has explained Luke's remote exercise. The second paragraph repeats the exercise before chapter 8 reaches its distinct subject, learning together.

editor_decision.reason: Le lien entre les exercices du Temple et ceux de Luke est le nouvel apport de ce retour : une methode traverse la destruction de l institution.

reviewer_reason: Chapters 1 and 15 cover this consultation, and chapter 8 adds no new incident or inference about children's instruction through it.

editor_decision.reason: Le passage montre que l education continue apres l apprentissage. Les archives servent ici a cet argument, au-dela de l enseignement des seuls enfants.

reviewer_reason: The chapter has already announced his attention to immediate lives and circumstances; this transition delays the first example.

editor_decision.reason: La transition relie un principe deja defini a son premier exemple ; elle reste breve et intelligible en narration calme.

reviewer_reason: The proposed edit to the preceding sentence incorporates this event; retaining both sentences would introduce an immediate duplicate.

editor_decision.reason: Cette remarque depend d une substitution precedente qui n a pas ete appliquee. Le fait de l invasion n est donc pas double dans le texte actuel.

reviewer_reason: The preceding sentence identifies Zett Jukassa as a young Jedi; calling him a child is unnecessarily imprecise for this encounter.

editor_decision.reason: Zett est bien un enfant et un jeune Jedi. La phrase precedente donne deja son role ; le mot enfant ne constitue pas une erreur factuelle.

reviewer_reason: Chapter 2 narrates the exercise and its meaning in detail. Here, the useful new point is how little instruction Luke receives before losing Obi-Wan.

editor_decision.reason: Le rappel de deux phrases a une fonction distincte : montrer la faible duree de transmission avant la mort d Obi-Wan, plutot que reexpliquer l exercice.

reviewer_reason: Chapter 2 has already developed Yoda's introduction and Luke's impatience. Chapter 28 needs the change in Luke's inheritance: another teacher, but no surviving school.

editor_decision.reason: La comparaison de Yoda avec une communaute enseignante est le sujet propre de l heritage incomplet ; elle justifie le bref retour a Dagobah.

reviewer_reason: Chapter 2 recounts both the cave and Luke's decision to leave. This passage can keep the consequence for his incomplete education without replaying both scenes.

editor_decision.reason: La sequence explique comment la sortie prematuree de formation conduit a affronter Vader. Elle ne repete pas la longue demonstration de l X-wing retiree plus tot.

reviewer_reason: Chapter 2 has already covered Luke's defeat and rescue. Vader's revelation and its effect on Obi-Wan's account are the distinct developments needed here.

editor_decision.reason: La revelation de la paternite invalide le recit recu d Obi-Wan, consequence essentielle dans le chapitre consacre a la transmission familiale.
